manifest.purpose: Unchanged-production native baseline for catalog version resolution, true CTE bodies and retained SQLc role coverage.

contracts.counterfactual_scope: Only model.lgo is replaced by its exact pre-r40 bytes from 4bde2ec5; all other production and new permanent tests remain current. This proves added retained pipeline assertions; it is not an old full-source checkout.

manifest.native_contract_scope: 37 original statements and 36 actual SQLc-processed statements must produce frozen native final values. The exact nested CTE remains native-valid/direct-allow, but pinned SQLc rejects it upstream with relation b absent; require the recorded diagnostic, no plugin request and no generated files. PostgreSQL does not interpret plugin configuration.

preserved_failed_baselines.diagnostic: complexity::cognitive_overflow: function versionCatalogRequest is too complex: nesting depth 4 exceeds 3, cognitive score 18 exceeds 15

fixture_corrections.scope: Read ordinary Generate results only after err==nil; exact diagnostic and successful-result assertions remain. Refusal no-output coverage is enforced by the real SQLc observer's zero-generated-files requirement.
No input, expected outcome, test assertion, or column-substitution order changes. Extract only the existing inner loop; count every original version column exactly as before.

observer_correction.scope: Original SQL, native state and positive direct-generator contract are unchanged. Distinguish the exact observed upstream SQLc refusal from a Spira refusal; require actual no-request/no-output behavior in this repeat.
observer_correction.evidence_size: Store canonical catalog SHA-256/byte length in each result and keep every complete request.json in the artifact. Generated contents and full query metadata stay exact. No gate is reused.
